maya: pre-handoff check-in :wave:

maya: quick summary of last 6h — we had two pages from embeddings autoscaler around 02:12 and 03:07 UTC. both mitigated by scale-up and manual eviction

incident-bot: PAGE triggered: embeddings-autoscaler (sev3) at 02:12 UTC — auto remedied at 02:18 UTC by policy-scale

liam: saw a brief p95 spike on /v1/embeddings, spike matched autoscaler control-loop

sharon: customer-facing impact? any errors surfaced to logged requests?

liam: no 5xxs in logs, increased latencies for a ~20m window, downstream retry rate up ~3%, no SLO breach yet

maya: current status: autoscaler policy adjusted (min_replicas 2 -> 3) for eu-west cluster until 14:00 UTC. also added a short cooldown param tweak

maya: runbook pointers: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler ; quick ops cmds:

maya: ```
# check pods
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embeddings
# check HPA
kubectl describe hpa embeddings -n inference
``` 

teja: leaving a note — primary for next 4h: liam, secondary: sharon. timezone overlap declared: liam in PDT, sharon in CET. they have escalation steps

liam: got it. i'll watch the horizon window and keep alert on >p95 latency alert

sharon: i'll pick up if liam needs to escalate — have playbook open and can run manual evictions

maya: coverage gap: 02:00-04:00 PST tomorrow morning there's a rotation hole between APAC oncall policy and US late-night; proposed mitigation: enable burst-capacity for eu-west during that window and leave a remote runbook on-call link

maya: action items before handoff:
- liam: confirm autoscaler param persisted to config (cfg repo)
- sharon: pre-stage eviction script in /ops/scripts/evict-embeddings.sh and test on staging
- teja: create a 4h monitor for increased retry rate and tag liam/sharon

ops-bot: deployment check — no rolling updates detected in last 2h

incident-bot: All current pages for embeddings-autoscaler are resolved. No open incidents.

maya: last note: customers to notify? not needed yet. i'll stitch a short postmortem if we see repeat in next 48h

liam: ok handing over — keeping pager on for next 2h then off. :thumbsup:

sharon: ack, will follow up at first sign of reoccurence

maya: thanks — handoff complete. :tada:
